title: The Smiling Hymn
author: O. M. Sterling
blurb: Kestrel Villalobos, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
